Name: Harvey Attends Aerobics
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]With this mod, Harvey will finally be able to fully join the aerobics club each Tuesday! It also applies some light tweaks to the event itself so that it only triggers on a Tuesday and to improve the dialogue - no more wondering why you've never seen Harvey at aerobics before, or laughing about him asking you to keep it a secret when the town's biggest gossips are right there beside him.

In order to free up his schedule on Tuesdays, Harvey now does annual checkups for townspeople on Mondays and Thursdays instead, with all relevant characters having adjusted schedules to match. Two additional tweaks include Leah keeping her annual check-up even once the Desert Festival is accessible (Maru will cover for Harvey at the medical tent instead) and Harvey still giving check-ups even when it's raining.

[/size][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=3]Simply download and drop the "[CP] Harvey Attends Aerobics" folder into your Mods folder.

[/size][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][size=3]

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22955]Immersive Characters - Shane[/url]﻿'s new check-up schedule for Shane.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35038]Harvey Cares [/url]- new dialogue is added if both mods are used together!

Untested but should be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast[/url]'s schedule changes as long as its Good Doctor Harvey config setting is disabled.

Untested with other mods that affect schedules, but should theoretically be compatible as long as they're not fully replacing schedules or changing clinic days. The following characters have their schedules affected: Harvey, Alex, Clint, Elliott, Evelyn, George, Haley (Haley's check-up day is moved to Fall 15 since Winter 8 is a festival day), Leah, Lewis, Maru, and Willy.

[b]Harvey Attends Aerobics may or may not be compatible with SVE. I will not provide compatibility if it is not.

[/b]Portrait & sprite mod used in screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url].

French translation by Mazoout![/size]
